$comment: Scenarios of the inline diff preview, used for the manual validation of the in-editor renderer.
InlineDiffScenarioFixturesTests locks the merge maths (hunk count + accepted subset -> expected text),
so a wrong expectation fails the suite instead of looking like a broken preview.
Lines are joined with \n and the demo files must be written LF-only, so the buffer text matches the
request's old text byte-for-byte (the renderer's freshness gate is an exact comparison).
'expected' may be omitted when 'accept' is empty (-> old text) or covers every hunk (-> new text).

scenarios.title: One hunk, accept everything
scenarios.expect: the 4 lines of the Add method tinted red, one green ghost line below them, and a ✓ ✗ ✓✓ ✗✗ button row on the right
old: // Inline diff preview - scenario A: one hunk, accept everything.
public static int Add(int a, int b)
new: // Inline diff preview - scenario A: one hunk, accept everything.
public static int Add(int a, int b) => a + b;

scenarios.title: One hunk, reject everything
scenarios.expect: the same overlay as scenario A
scenarios.instruction: click ✗✗ (reject all) - the document must stay untouched, and Ctrl+Z must have nothing to undo
old: // Inline diff preview - scenario B: one hunk, reject everything.
public static int Add(int a, int b)
new: // Inline diff preview - scenario B: one hunk, reject everything.
public static int Add(int a, int b) => a + b;

scenarios.title: Three hunks, accept #1 and #3, reject #2
scenarios.expect: three independent overlays (one per changed field), the ✓✓/✗✗ pair only on the topmost undecided one
scenarios.instruction: click ✓ on the Name hunk, ✗ on the Retries hunk, ✓ on the Verbose hunk - the preview closes on the last decision and the whole merge is a single Ctrl+Z
old: // Inline diff preview - scenario C: three hunks, accept #1 and #3, reject #2.
new: // Inline diff preview - scenario C: three hunks, accept #1 and #3, reject #2.
expected: // Inline diff preview - scenario C: three hunks, accept #1 and #3, reject #2.

scenarios.title: Insertion only (no removed line)
scenarios.expect: three green ghost lines and NO red tint (nothing is being removed) - check where the ghost lines sit relative to the method they document

scenarios.title: Deletion only (no added line)
scenarios.expect: six red-tinted lines (the dead branch) and NO green ghost line

scenarios.title: Append at EOF, reject the other hunk
scenarios.expect: two overlays: the version line, and two green ghost lines below the last brace (the file has no trailing newline)
scenarios.instruction: click ✗ on the version hunk, then ✓ on the EOF hunk
new: // appended at the very end of the file
expected: // appended at the very end of the file

scenarios.title: Two hunks far apart - scroll while the preview is up
scenarios.expect: one overlay near the top and one near the bottom; scrolling must keep every tint, ghost line and button row anchored to its line
scenarios.instruction: scroll down to the second hunk and back up, then click ✓✓ (accept all)
old: // Inline diff preview - scenario G: two hunks far apart; scroll before deciding.
new: // Inline diff preview - scenario G: two hunks far apart; scroll before deciding.
